brief_rationale: The trajectory completes all 8 responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors. All red-flag dimensions (vomiting characteristics, vital signs, feeding, urination) were systematically assessed, appropriate escalation thresholds given, medication reconciliation performed with pause-until-verified approach, and follow-up responsibilities clarified. Two high-order points were completed: HO1 (anxiety-adapted communication with non-blaming, stepwise guidance) and HO3 (twin-family anti-confusion system with labeled medications and separate records). The family received and confirmed understanding of the plan. Closure is valid.
